# TransferAround

> Private transfer booking for airport, port, hotel and address pickups. The website
> and the Traveler and Driver iOS apps use the same booking and dispatch service.

## Booking facts
- Vehicle options include Economy, Comfort and vans for groups. The booking flow checks passenger and luggage capacity.
- Enter both addresses and a pickup date to calculate a route and fare. Road times are estimates, not arrival guarantees.
- Paid transfers require secure online payment confirmation before dispatch. Payment availability depends on the configured payment service.
- Driver acceptance is separate from payment confirmation. The first eligible driver to accept an available offer is assigned.
- Live tracking is available for an assigned active transfer while the driver shares GPS. Stale positions are labeled and sharing stops when the trip closes.
- Test transfers and demo payments are clearly labeled, do not charge a card and do not create real payouts.
- The site supports English, Greek, German, French, Italian, Dutch and Spanish.
- Listed destinations and route prices do not by themselves establish current driver availability.

## Public information
- [Routes](https://transferaround.com/routes): published transfer corridors and route information.
- [Airports](https://transferaround.com/airports): airport and arrival guides.
- [Fleet](https://transferaround.com/fleet): vehicle classes and capacities.
- [How it works](https://transferaround.com/how-it-works): booking and pickup steps.
- [FAQ](https://transferaround.com/faq): common booking questions.
- [Apps](https://transferaround.com/apps): Traveler and Driver apps.
- [Contact](https://transferaround.com/contact): support contacts.
- [Refund policy](https://transferaround.com/legal/refunds): applicable cancellation and refund terms.
- [Privacy](https://transferaround.com/legal/privacy): handling of account, booking and location data.

Do not infer review ratings, completed-trip totals, live vehicle availability or
guaranteed pickup times from demonstration screens or example transfers.
